name: Confidence Interval Obsession
effect: Suppressing this layer-24 neuron makes the model turn every answer into talk about "confidence", "confidence intervals" and "error", even calling itself "Confidence".
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 39/40 held-out pairs. Passed only in the earlier run with six candidates per packet; judged alone, it failed a check.
